caseno: Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 1946 of 2009
lawyer: Saidur Rahman on behalf of Syed Mahbubar Rahman, Advocate-on-Record ----- For the Respondents
parties:
Mojibor and another -----Petitioners
Vs.
Md. Nurul Islam and others ----- Respondents
full_judgment: 4. Mr. A. J. Mohammad Ali, learned Counsel, appearing for the petitioners submitted that the trial Court on consideration of evidence on record dismissed the suit in holding that after abolition of Zamindary system the suit property was lying abandoned and taking that advantage both the plaintiff and contesting defendants are trying their best for garbing the suit property with all vague and fraudulent papers; that the plaintiff claimed title by way of registered deed of. exchange dated 30.03.1985 with one Md. Siddiqur Rahman who claimed himself as the son of Sheik Wahab All and from the pleading of the plaintiff the plaint and the oral evidence of P.W.'s same contradictions appears regarding acquisitions of title of Sheikh Wahab AIi by way of pattan from superior Zamindar the High Court Division in absence of proof of chain of title of the plaintiffs predecessor declared title of the plaintiff on the llagis of judgment of earlier suit being Title Suit No. 215 of 1984 filed by Md. Siddiqur Rahman and Title Suit No. 106 of 1981 in the Court of the then 1st Munsif Court, Manikganj which was before the registered deed of exchange dated 30.03.1985; that the plaintiffs predecessor got 3 pattans in 1351, 1352 and .1353 B.S. corresponding to 1944 A.D., 1945 A.D. and 1946 A.D. which was considered by the trial Court as exhitit-1, 1(a) and 1(b) of earlier Title Suit No.215 of 1984 in which the S.A. Khatian numbers were inserted although S.A. operation started after the abolition of zamindary system and finally published in 1962 A.D. the High Court Division over-looked that in a document of 1944, 1945 and 1946 A.D. the number came in the year 1962 inserted upon fraudulent Act and thus, committed error of law in decreeing the suit. The learned Counsel further submitted that upon fraudulent document no declaration of title cannot be declared by a competent Court, the High Court Division erred in law in decreeing the suit without formal proof of exhibit-6 shows 1st party's name Siddiqur Rahman who belonged 'Ka' scheduled property comprising plot Nos. 595, 455, 674 and 707 but exhibit Nos.Kha(7), Kha(4) and Kha(10) show that Nurul Islam was not owner in plot Nos. 155, 455, 495, 707 and 674 and thus plaintiff Nurul Islam was not owner of 16 annas share in 'Kha' schedule property of exhibit No. 6 and thus the deed of exchange was executed by giving upon vague schedule of land and the plaintiff did not acquire title over 'Ka' schedule of property of exhibit-6; that the trial Court found the pattans in the name of Sheikh Wahab Ali a forged,- fraudulent antedated and further no possession was delivered vide exhibit No. 6, the High Court Division nowhere discussed those material evidence but decreed the suit in holding that the plaintiffs title has been declared in earlier suit in which Md. Siddiqur Rahman was plaintiff and thus, the judgment is liable to be set aside.
